:::{#rem-column-vector-convention}
#### Vectors are columns by default

In these notes, as in most statistics textbooks,
a vector is a column vector unless stated otherwise.
A vector written inline as a list in parentheses is still a column vector:
for example, $\vx = (2, -1, 5)$ means

$$
\vx =
\begin{bmatrix}
2 \\
-1 \\
5
\end{bmatrix}.
$$

:::
